description: Canonical full-jitter exponential backoff vectors (ADR-0114 D24). The curve is ceiling = min(base * 2^n, max), and the returned delay is jitter(ceiling), uniform over [0, ceiling]. TWO implementations must satisfy this file: agentmgr.DaemonRestartPolicy (REACT-04 / ADR-0070, core internal) and pipeline.RetryPolicy (ADR-0114 D18, premium). They cannot share code — REACT-04 lives in core's internal tree and is unreachable from premium — so this file is the control that a 'must mirror' comment could never be. If you change either curve, this file fails with a concrete number in the package you changed.
attempt_indexing: n is ZERO-BASED (first attempt is n=0). agentmgr uses n directly; pipeline.Backoff takes a 1-based attempt, so it is called with n+1.
jitter_bounds: For every vector, the returned delay must lie in [0, ceiling_ms] inclusive. Injecting a jitter that returns 0 must yield 0; injecting one that returns its argument must yield exactly ceiling_ms. The high-n vectors exist to catch a float64 overflow producing +Inf or a negative integer wrap; both must still clamp to max_ms.
